citations.label: From Industry Claims to Empirical Reality: Code Review Agents in Pull Requests (arXiv 2604.03196v1)
citations.excerpt: 60.2% of closed CRA-only PRs fall into the 0–30% signal range, and 12 of 13 CRAs exhibit average signal ratios below 60%

citations.label: Empirical study of code review agents, merge-rate finding (arXiv 2604.03196v1)
citations.excerpt: CRA-only PRs achieve a 45.20% merge rate, 23.17 percentage points lower than human-only PRs (68.37%), with significantly higher abandonment

citations.label: Agent pull requests are everywhere. Here's how to review them. (GitHub Blog)
citations.excerpt: More than one in five code reviews on GitHub now involve an agent.
